description: Three sessions (Codex, Claude Code, Codex) on a blog publishing pipeline. Tests constraints set two sessions earlier.

turns.user: Build the blog banner pipeline. Rule: an article is never published without its banner.
turns.reply: Agreed: publication stays blocked until the banner exists. Banners go to web/public/blog/banners/<slug>.webp at exactly 1600×900.

turns.user: What size limit do inline images have?
turns.reply: Inline media must be sRGB WebP, exactly 1600×900 and at most 320 KiB each.

turns.user: Generate the banner draft for article {n}.
turns.reply: Banner draft {n} is ready for review.
The slug link-in-bio-vs-linktree failed: its comparison lacks a current screenshot of the official Linktree pricing page.

turns.user: Run the banner contract for batch {n}.

turns.reply: The production build passes; the banner contract test ran first, as designed.
The sitemap now lists 18 live articles; link-in-bio-vs-linktree stays excluded until its screenshot is captured.
Next: capture the Linktree pricing page from a fresh browser context without cookies or a login wall.
